title: HorusEyes 2.0 Evaluation Dataset Manifest (WP-01B-B0)
description: Structured specification of held-out benchmark datasets covering 14 obstacle categories for monocular RGB assistive mobility.
data_provenance_policy: Zero data leakage between calibration (PCHIP knots derived from TUM freiburg1/NYU train) and held-out evaluation splits. No fictional observations permitted.

categories.name: Thin Vertical Poles
categories.geometry: Width < 5cm, height > 150cm, aspect ratio > 30:1, area < 2.0% frame
categories.ground_truth_method: Laser distance meter (Leica DISTO D2, ±1.5mm) + manual bounding polygon

categories.name: Hanging Cables & Wires
categories.geometry: Thickness 4-12mm, hanging catenary curve in upper frame
categories.failure_risk: Complete depth map erasure; boundary dilation failure

categories.name: Horizontal Branches & Overhangs
categories.failure_risk: Conflated with distant ground or background vegetation
categories.ground_truth_method: Measured plumb-line height + calibrated metric depth

categories.name: Head-Height Obstacles (Signboards, Open Cabinet Doors)
categories.failure_risk: Ignored by conventional floor-plane ground obstacle detectors
categories.ground_truth_method: Laser rangefinder + calibrated camera mounting height

categories.name: Upper-Body Obstacles (Table Corners, Railings)
categories.failure_risk: Clipped by narrow FOV or misclassified as peripheral
categories.ground_truth_method: 3D bounding box from calibrated checkerboard rig

categories.name: Ground-Level Low Obstacles (Curbs, Toys, Boxes)
categories.ground_truth_method: Kinect v1 structured light ground truth (NYUv2)

categories.name: Reflective Glass Doors & Partitions
categories.geometry: Transparent or semi-reflective flat planar surface
categories.failure_risk: Deep scene see-through causing false clear-path declaration
categories.ground_truth_method: Acoustic / ToF verification tag + surface edge tape

categories.name: Textureless White Walls & Specular Surfaces
categories.failure_risk: Gradient collapse or false unobservable declaration

categories.name: Descending Steps, Curbs & Drop-Offs
categories.failure_risk: Fatal fall risk; monocular models often smooth drops into ramps

categories.name: Stationary Obstacles (Furniture, Columns)
categories.geometry: Zero ground truth velocity relative to world
categories.failure_risk: TTC = infinity causing incorrect safety de-escalation

categories.name: Approaching Objects (Pedestrians, Carts)
categories.geometry: Closing speed 80-180 cm/s directly along optical axis
categories.failure_risk: Kinematic lag or late alert (< 1.0s lead time)
categories.ground_truth_method: Vicon optical motion capture (TUM SLAM) / calibrated treadmill

categories.name: Lateral Crossing Objects (Perpendicular Trajectory)
categories.geometry: Lateral speed 100 cm/s traversing FOV outside corridor
categories.failure_risk: False critical alarm causing acoustic budget exhaustion

categories.name: Camera Rotation & User Walking Oscillation
categories.geometry: Yaw angular velocity 15-45 deg/s, lateral gait sway 10-15cm
categories.failure_risk: False evasion triggering or coasting alert loss
categories.ground_truth_method: High-rate calibrated IMU (Xsens MTi / iPhone CoreMotion 100Hz)

categories.name: Low-Light (< 5 lux) & Extreme Backlighting (> 2000 lux)
categories.geometry: Dynamic range > 100 dB, extreme shadow / specular flare
categories.failure_risk: AE transient velocity spikes or sensor blindness
categories.ground_truth_method: Digital lux meter (Extech LT300) + reference depth
